tagline: Free step-by-step guides that actually get you unstuck.

pillars.label: Getting Found by AI
pillars.blurb: Show up when people ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google's AI for someone like you. This is the AEO stuff, in plain words.

pillars.label: AI for Beginners
pillars.blurb: Never really used it? Start here. The basics, the way I wish someone showed me.

pillars.label: Get More Customers
pillars.blurb: Guides for filling your calendar: reviews, referrals, follow-up, showing up local.

pillars.label: Save Time with AI
pillars.blurb: Little systems that hand the boring work to a robot so you get your hours back.

pillars.label: Run Your Business Smarter
pillars.blurb: Tools, workflows, and habits to keep the whole thing from living in your head.

guides.title: Get into the Launchpad
guides.oneLineOutcome: For new Stratosphere members: sign in, say hi, and find the Monday call, the replays and the workshops. Private, linked from the welcome emails and the thank-you page.

guides.title: Make an Open House Flyer with ChatGPT Images 2.5
guides.oneLineOutcome: Turn your real listing photo into a print-ready open house flyer with one copy-paste prompt, fix any mistakes, make a square Instagram version, and cut out your headshot.

guides.title: Test Grok 4.7 Against the AI You Already Use
guides.oneLineOutcome: Grok 4.7 isn't in the Grok app yet, so put it side by side with Claude or ChatGPT on OpenRouter, give both the same listing job, and pick a winner on four questions.

guides.title: Build a Lead Form That Sorts Hot, Warm and Cold with Jev
guides.oneLineOutcome: Have Claude build a buyer lead form that uses Jev to sort every lead into hot, warm or cold as they answer, with a $5 spending cap and fair housing rules built in.

guides.title: New Claude Just Dropped. Give Your Setup a Tune-Up.
guides.oneLineOutcome: Clean out the old rules, memory notes and add-ons Claude reads every session, then install /tuneup, one command that finds outdated or conflicting rules and fixes only the ones you pick.

guides.title: Turn On the New Siri and Give It Three Real Jobs
guides.oneLineOutcome: Update to iOS 27, turn on Siri AI (waitlist and all), find the new Siri app, then give it the three asks that prove the new Siri is different: dig up a buried detail, turn a text into a calendar event, ask about what is on your screen.

guides.title: See Every Ad Your Competitors Are Running
guides.oneLineOutcome: Walk the Meta Ad Library one click at a time, then paste one prompt so Claude scores the ads your competitors keep paying for and turns them into six ad ideas for you.

guides.title: 3 Prompts to Try in Fable 5.1 Tonight
guides.oneLineOutcome: Three copy and paste prompts that show you what Fable 5.1 can do: one job handed off, an honest audit, and a step-by-step plan for the thing you keep avoiding.

guides.title: How to Use Fable 5
guides.oneLineOutcome: Get real work out of Fable 5, the smartest AI model, one step at a time.

guides.title: Set Up Grok Bot (Hire Your First AI Team)
guides.oneLineOutcome: Go from nothing to a working team of AI employees in Grok Bot, one step at a time.

guides.title: Is Your Website Blocking AI?
guides.oneLineOutcome: Check in ten seconds whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google can read your website, and get the exact fix if they cannot.
